label: Pregnant or just gave birth, bleeding
blood_products: red cells + plasma (FFP) + cryoprecipitate, possibly platelets
rationale: Obstetric haemorrhage can need surgery (C-section, laparotomy) and quickly uses up clotting factors, so whole blood alone is not enough

label: Accident or injury, bleeding
rationale: Major trauma bleeding needs surgical control and balanced component transfusion

label: Severe weakness or anaemia, no injury
rationale: Stable severe anaemia needs red cells and admission, not emergency surgery

label: Not sure / other
rationale: Assume the worst: treat as a bleeding emergency until assessed
